Guides

Hide the Facebook feed on Mac

Most of what keeps you on Facebook is the news feed. Burnfeed removes it from facebook.com in Safari and leaves a quote in its place, so you can check a message or an event and get out.

How to do it

  1. 1. Buy it on burnfeed.app ($4.99 once) or from the Mac App Store, and open the app once.
  2. 2. Choose Safari › Settings › Extensions, tick Burnfeed, and allow it on the site.
  3. 3. Open the site and click the Burnfeed button in Safari's toolbar. Switch the feed, or single parts of the page, on or off.

What Burnfeed hides on Facebook

  • The news feed on the home page
  • Stories at the top of the feed
  • The groups feed, if you switch it on

Messenger, notifications, groups you open, events, Marketplace and your profile keep working. Need the feed for a moment? Show it for 5, 15 or 60 minutes and it burns again on its own.

Without an extension

Facebook's Feeds tab can sort by Friends or Favorites, but the home page always opens on the main feed again.

Questions

Does it delete anything from my account?

No. Burnfeed only hides the feed on your screen in Safari. Nothing changes on Facebook.

Does it work on Facebook's other domains?

It works on www.facebook.com and web.facebook.com in Safari on Mac.
